pages.text: Create: New Age integrates Create's rotation network with Forge Energy (FE) — the standard power format shared by most tech mods. Rotation becomes electricity, and electricity becomes rotation.$(br2)$(bold)Alternator:$() Mount on any rotating shaft. Converts RPM → FE. Output scales with shaft speed — faster spin, more power.

$(bold)Electric Motor:$() The reverse — consumes FE to produce rotation. Useful when you want to power Create machines from a solar or nuclear source.$(br2)$(bold)Solar Panels:$() Passive, low output. Fine for small draws or supplementing a larger grid.$(br2)$(bold)Nuclear Reactor:$() Serious late-game infrastructure. High FE output, needs fuel rods and active cooling.

$(bold)Why bother:$() Several Create addons installed in this pack require FE rather than direct rotation. Getting an Alternator onto your existing Create network takes minutes and unlocks a significant portion of late-game content.$(br2)Start with a solar panel or a small alternator on a windmill shaft. Scale up from there.
